text.title: GraphQL API Design Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the spec artefact this methodology produces. Validator in scripts/validate-graphql-api-design.py enforces required keys, enum bounds, and pattern constraints.

section.title: Schema

example.note: All required keys present; enums and patterns satisfied; every shape counter sits at its hard maximum of 0.
Forbidden traits: Missing required auth_strategy; pagination_style enum violation; max_depth above 12; non_payload_mutations and scalar_id_relations above the hard maximum of 0.

list.item: A mutation returning a scalar (Boolean, ID) instead of a <Name>Payload type.
A validation or business-rule failure surfaced through the transport errors[] rather than userErrors[].
An authorization check embedded in a resolver body instead of declared as a directive or permission class.
A paginated list without the Connection/Edge/PageInfo wrapper.
A relation exposing a raw scalar id instead of a Relay opaque global ID.
A DataLoader instantiated at module scope rather than per request.
Sort SDL types alphabetically for diff hygiene.
